title: The home page shows a visible FAQ and emits FAQPage structured data from the quick-answers corpus
detail:
The answer-first quick answers feed only llms.txt. Home emits no FAQPage (app/page.tsx comment confirms). Add the FAQ to the home template so the published document renders it, then re-publish. Voice per the language guide.

2026-10-26: #3926 put a visible Questions section and a matching FAQPage node on the live Frequency home (components/frequency/site/pages/home/frequency-home.tsx, app/page.tsx, homeFaq in lib/marketing/quick-answers.ts). The probe still reads the unreachable DAWN template lib/page-editor/templates/home.ts, so the row stays open until the probe is pointed at the live path (needs the owner's word to change a probe).

verify.note: Exits 0 only when the repair has landed; fails on main today.
